correctness.rationale: The proof classifies Birkhoff--James support directions by the regular octagon’s edge/vertex normal cones. Edge-supported pairs satisfy the bound from the flat segment followed by a one-ray estimate. Vertex-supported pairs split into the two exact unit-direction branches; each quotient is maximized at the intersection of two controlling affine norm pieces, with monotone endpoint formulas. The witness has unit x and y, is tangent to a supporting edge, and gives denominator 1 at lambda=2(sqrt(2)-1).

value.rationale: The rectangular constant is a standard geometric invariant tied to Birkhoff--James orthogonality, and the regular octagon is a canonical non-Hilbert, uniformly nonsquare test plane. An exact value provides a concrete benchmark between the Hilbert lower endpoint sqrt(2) and the universal upper endpoint 3, and separates this invariant from nearby octagonal constants even where a numerical coincidence occurs.
